injuries.longComment: It's the second surgery that Durbin has undergone in the last three weeks -- this time to address a toe injury that he'd picked up on his foot. He'll have an entire offseason to recover from the procedures, giving him a strong chance to be fully healthy by the time spring training begins.
injuries.shortComment: The Red Sox announced Thursday that Durbin (finger) underwent a successful partial excision of the fifth metatarsal base with tendon repair on his right foot, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
